test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits to the immediate left of C. E sits third to the right of D. D is an immediate neighbour of C. B is an immediate neighbour of both E and F. Who is the immediate neighbour of C and E?
solution:
Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. E sits third to the right of D.

2. B is an immediate neighbour of both E and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cee3a149c696c86284c154a4022b413fddfa8f384ac69650d658204e0b4c5dc.png] 

3. D is an immediate neighbour of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6445fab0edff21935f1d7dcf37f55c7983787c4430d2e6f3c129e718a519dd80.png] 

4. A sits to the immediate left of C - Case I is not valid from this statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/433737a5bbdc21f881f30692d43e0a7497f34ffd566f99ccbeb616e675d07ea5.png] 

Clearly, A is the immediate neighbour of C and E.

Hence, '**A**' is the correct answer.
